inputs.text: Calling Senate Bill 175 a “limited safeguard” doesn’t make it harmless. Restricting new registrants in state elections still puts another barrier between people and the ballot, while “confidence” rhetoric can make exclusion sound like responsible governance. Voting should be accessible, and any state rule that narrows who gets to participate deserves serious scrutiny—not a presumption that it protects democracy.
